description.en: Lobules I–V, in front of the primary fissure on the superior surface of the cerebellum. Its cortex receives spinocerebellar input and is somatotopically mapped (the 'inverted homunculus').
description.uz: Miyachaning yuqori yuzasida, birlamchi yoriqdan oldindagi I–V bo'lakchalar. Po'stlog'i spinotserebellyar signallarni oladi va somatotopik xaritalangan ('teskari gomunkulus').

role.en: The spinocerebellum for the limbs and trunk: online correction of muscle tone, posture and the execution of ongoing limb movement.
role.uz: Oyoq-qo'l va tana uchun spinotserebellum: mushak tonusi, gavda holati va davom etayotgan harakatni real vaqtda tuzatish.

clinical.en: Preferentially degenerates in chronic alcoholism (anterior superior vermis) → wide-based gait ataxia with relatively spared arms.
clinical.uz: Surunkali alkogolizmda tanlab degeneratsiyaga uchraydi (old-yuqori chuvalchang) → qo'llar nisbatan saqlangan holda keng qadamli yurish ataksiyasi.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Anatomy of the cerebellum

description.en: Lobules VI–IX, between the primary and posterolateral fissures — by far the largest lobe, containing the massive Crus I/II of the hemispheres and the tonsils (hemispheric IX).
description.uz: Birlamchi va orqa-yon yoriqlar orasidagi VI–IX bo'lakchalar — eng katta bo'lak; yarim sharlarning ulkan Crus I/II va bodomchalarini (yarim shar IX) o'z ichiga oladi.

role.en: The cerebrocerebellum: planning and timing of skilled voluntary movement (lobule VI, VIII) plus the cognitive-affective cerebellum (Crus I/II, VIIb) linked to prefrontal and parietal association cortex.
role.uz: Tserebrotserebellum: nozik ixtiyoriy harakatni rejalash va vaqtlash (VI, VIII bo'lakchalar) hamda prefrontal va parietal assotsiativ po'stloq bilan bog'langan kognitiv-affektiv miyacha (Crus I/II, VIIb).

clinical.en: Posterior-lobe lesions cause the cerebellar cognitive affective (Schmahmann) syndrome; tonsillar herniation through the foramen magnum (Chiari I, raised ICP) involves lobule IX.
clinical.uz: Orqa bo'lak zararlanishi miyacha kognitiv-affektiv (Schmahmann) sindromini beradi; bodomchalarning katta teshik orqali churrasi (Chiari I, yuqori ICP) IX bo'lakchaga tegishli.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Anatomy of the cerebellum
Wikipedia — Cerebellar cognitive affective syndrome

description.en: Lobule X — the nodulus of the vermis and the two flocculi — the phylogenetically oldest part (archicerebellum), tucked beneath the posterior lobe next to the fourth ventricle and the cerebellopontine angle.
description.uz: X bo'lakcha — chuvalchang tuguni (nodulus) va ikki flokkulus — filogenetik eng qadimgi qism (arxitserebellum); orqa bo'lak ostida, IV qorincha va ko'prik-miyacha burchagi yonida joylashgan.

role.en: The vestibulocerebellum: balance, gaze stabilisation (vestibulo-ocular reflex adaptation, smooth pursuit) and gaze holding.
role.uz: Vestibulotserebellum: muvozanat, qarashni barqarorlashtirish (vestibulo-okulyar refleks moslashuvi, silliq kuzatish) va qarashni ushlab turish.

clinical.en: Damage (medulloblastoma in children arises next to it) produces truncal ataxia, nystagmus and vertigo with normal limb coordination.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi (bolalardagi medulloblastoma uning yonida paydo bo'ladi) oyoq-qo'l muvofiqligi saqlangan holda gavda ataksiyasi, nistagm va bosh aylanishini beradi.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Flocculonodular lobe

description.en: Four paired nuclei buried in the cerebellar white matter — from lateral to medial the dentate, emboliform and globose (together the interposed) and fastigial nuclei — receiving inhibitory Purkinje-cell output and excitatory collaterals of mossy and climbing fibres.
description.uz: Miyacha oq moddasiga ko'milgan to'rt juft yadro — lateraldan medialga tishsimon, tiqinsimon va sharsimon (birgalikda oraliq) hamda chodirsimon yadrolar; Purkinje hujayralarining tormozlovchi chiqishi va moxsimon/o'rmalovchi tolalarning qo'zg'atuvchi kollaterallarini oladi.

role.en: The sole output of the cerebellum: every cerebellar influence on the thalamus, red nucleus, vestibular nuclei and reticular formation passes through them.
role.uz: Miyachaning yagona chiqishi: talamus, qizil yadro, vestibulyar yadrolar va retikulyar formatsiyaga miyacha ta'siri faqat ular orqali o'tadi.

clinical.en: Injury during posterior-fossa tumour surgery (especially to the dentate and its efferents) causes cerebellar mutism syndrome in children; iron-rich dentate is hypointense on SWI.
clinical.uz: Orqa chuqurcha o'smalari jarrohligida (ayniqsa tishsimon yadro va uning chiqish tolalari) jarohat bolalarda miyacha mutizmi sindromini keltiradi; temirga boy tishsimon yadro SWI'da gipointensiv.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Deep cerebellar nuclei

description.en: The most anterior cerebellar lobules — lingula (I), central lobule (II–III) and the anterior culmen (IV) — forming the roof of the fourth ventricle beside the superior medullary velum.
description.uz: Eng oldingi miyacha bo'lakchalari — lingula (I), markaziy bo'lakcha (II–III) va oldingi culmen (IV); yuqori miya pardasi yonida IV qorincha tomini hosil qiladi.

role.en: Spinocerebellar representation of the lower limbs and trunk; lobule I also receives vestibular input.
role.uz: Oyoqlar va tananing spinotserebellyar vakilligi; I bo'lakcha vestibulyar signallarni ham oladi.

clinical.en: Together with lobule V and the vermis, the classic site of alcoholic cerebellar degeneration.
clinical.uz: V bo'lakcha va chuvalchang bilan birga alkogolli miyacha degeneratsiyasining klassik joyi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

description.en: The posterior culmen, immediately in front of the primary fissure, forming the summit of the superior cerebellar surface.
description.uz: Birlamchi yoriqdan bevosita oldindagi orqa culmen; miyachaning yuqori yuzasi cho'qqisini hosil qiladi.

role.en: Anterior-lobe representation of the upper limb and the hand (the first of the two hand maps of the cerebellum); active in simple finger movements.
role.uz: Qo'l va kaftning old bo'lak vakilligi (miyachadagi ikki kaft xaritasidan birinchisi); oddiy barmoq harakatlarida faol.

clinical.en: Lesions of lobules IV–V give ipsilateral upper-limb dysmetria and intention tremor.
clinical.uz: IV–V bo'lakchalar zararlanishi o'sha tomonda qo'l dismetriyasi va intension tremor beradi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

description.en: The first posterior-lobe lobule, just behind the primary fissure (hemispheric 'lobulus simplex', vermal 'declive').
description.uz: Birlamchi yoriqdan bevosita orqadagi orqa bo'lakning birinchi bo'lakchasi (yarim sharda 'lobulus simplex', chuvalchangda 'declive').

role.en: Motor lobule for the hand, mouth and eyes — strongly active in finger tapping, speech articulation and saccades; part of the 'oculomotor vermis' with VII.
role.uz: Kaft, og'iz va ko'zlar uchun harakat bo'lakchasi — barmoq bilan urish, nutq artikulyatsiyasi va sakkadalarda kuchli faol; VII bilan birga 'okulomotor chuvalchang' qismi.

clinical.en: Lobule VI lesions cause ataxic dysarthria and saccadic dysmetria; grey-matter loss here is reported in ADHD and autism.
clinical.uz: VI bo'lakcha zararlanishi ataktik dizartriya va sakkada dismetriyasini beradi; ADHD va autizmda bu yerda kulrang modda kamayishi qayd etilgan.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

description.en: The vermal part of lobule VI, immediately behind the primary fissure on the superior vermis.
description.uz: VI bo'lakchaning chuvalchang qismi; yuqori chuvalchangda birlamchi yoriqdan bevosita orqada.

role.en: Axial and oculomotor control: with vermal VII it forms the oculomotor vermis that calibrates saccade amplitude.
role.uz: O'q va okulomotor nazorat: chuvalchang VII bilan birga sakkada amplitudasini sozlovchi okulomotor chuvalchangni hosil qiladi.

clinical.en: Vermian atrophy (alcohol, phenytoin, paraneoplastic degeneration) gives truncal and gait ataxia and saccadic dysmetria.
clinical.uz: Chuvalchang atrofiyasi (alkogol, fenitoin, paraneoplastik degeneratsiya) gavda va yurish ataksiyasi hamda sakkada dismetriyasini beradi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

description.en: The huge anterior half of the ansiform lobule (VIIa), the largest lobule of the human cerebellum, spanning the posterolateral surface above the horizontal fissure.
description.uz: Ansiform bo'lakchaning (VIIa) ulkan oldingi yarmi — inson miyachasining eng katta bo'lakchasi; gorizontal yoriq ustidagi orqa-yon yuzani egallaydi.

role.en: Non-motor cerebellum: connected with dorsolateral prefrontal and posterior parietal cortex — working memory, language, executive function and the default-mode network.
role.uz: Harakatsiz miyacha: dorsolateral prefrontal va orqa parietal po'stloq bilan bog'langan — ishchi xotira, til, ijro funksiyalari va sukut rejimi tarmog'i.

clinical.en: Crus I/II lesions produce the cognitive-affective (Schmahmann) syndrome without ataxia; Crus I is the most common cerebellar site of stroke in the PICA/SCA watershed.
clinical.uz: Crus I/II zararlanishi ataksiyasiz kognitiv-affektiv (Schmahmann) sindromini beradi; Crus I — PICA/SCA chegarasida miyacha insultining eng ko'p uchraydigan joyi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum
Wikipedia — Cerebellar cognitive affective syndrome

description.en: The tiny vermal strip corresponding to Crus I — the folium vermis — a single narrow leaf at the posterior tip of the vermis.
description.uz: Crus I'ga mos keluvchi mitti chuvalchang chizig'i — folium vermis — chuvalchangning orqa uchidagi yagona tor barg.

role.en: Part of the oculomotor vermis (VI–VII) that tunes saccade accuracy.
role.uz: Sakkada aniqligini sozlovchi okulomotor chuvalchang (VI–VII) qismi.

clinical.en: Vermal VII lesions give hypometric or hypermetric saccades and ocular flutter.
clinical.uz: Chuvalchang VII zararlanishi gipometrik yoki gipermetrik sakkadalar va ko'z 'titrashi'ni beradi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

description.en: The posterior half of the ansiform lobule, below the horizontal fissure on the inferior surface, continuous medially with the tuber of the vermis.
description.uz: Ansiform bo'lakchaning orqa yarmi; pastki yuzada gorizontal yoriq ostida, medial tomonda chuvalchang tuber bilan tutash.

role.en: Like Crus I, a cognitive/associative lobule: language (right Crus II is active in verbal fluency), social cognition and the frontoparietal network. Contains the second cerebellar body map's face and hand regions at its border with VIIb.
role.uz: Crus I kabi kognitiv/assotsiativ bo'lakcha: til (o'ng Crus II so'z ravonligida faol), ijtimoiy kognitsiya va frontoparietal tarmoq. VIIb bilan chegarasida miyachaning ikkinchi tana xaritasi yuz va kaft sohalari joylashgan.

clinical.en: Right posterolateral (Crus II) lesions impair verbal fluency and language; the region is affected early in spinocerebellar ataxias with cognitive impairment.
clinical.uz: O'ng orqa-yon (Crus II) zararlanishi so'z ravonligi va tilni buzadi; kognitiv buzilishli spinotserebellyar ataksiyalarda erta zararlanadi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

description.en: The tuber of the vermis on the inferior surface — the vermal continuation of Crus II.
description.uz: Pastki yuzadagi chuvalchang tuberi — Crus II'ning chuvalchang davomi.

role.en: Posterior vermis: gait and trunk control together with autonomic and affective modulation (limbic cerebellum).
role.uz: Orqa chuvalchang: yurish va gavda nazorati, vegetativ va affektiv modulyatsiya (limbik miyacha) bilan birga.

clinical.en: Posterior vermis damage in children (medulloblastoma resection) contributes to emotional dysregulation of cerebellar mutism syndrome.
clinical.uz: Bolalarda orqa chuvalchang zararlanishi (medulloblastoma rezeksiyasi) miyacha mutizmi sindromidagi hissiy buzilishga hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

description.en: The paramedian lobule on the inferior surface, between Crus II and lobule VIIIa, continuous with the tuber of the vermis.
description.uz: Pastki yuzadagi paramedian bo'lakcha; Crus II bilan VIIIa orasida, chuvalchang tuber bilan tutash.

role.en: Transition between the cognitive Crus I/II and the motor lobule VIII — involved in working memory, saccades and hand movements of the second body map.
role.uz: Kognitiv Crus I/II bilan harakat bo'lakchasi VIII orasidagi o'tish — ishchi xotira, sakkadalar va ikkinchi tana xaritasining kaft harakatlarida ishtirok etadi.

clinical.en: Included in inferior cerebellar (PICA) infarcts; isolated involvement is rarely symptomatic.
clinical.uz: Pastki miyacha (PICA) infarktlarida zararlanadi; alohida zararlanishi kam simptom beradi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

description.en: The vermal strip of lobule VIIb on the inferior vermis.
description.uz: Pastki chuvalchangdagi VIIb bo'lakchaning chuvalchang chizig'i.

role.en: Posterior vermis contribution to gait, posture and the oculomotor vermis.
role.uz: Orqa chuvalchangning yurish, gavda holati va okulomotor chuvalchangga hissasi.

clinical.en: Damaged with the rest of the posterior vermis in midline tumours of childhood.
clinical.uz: Bolalik davri o'rta chiziq o'smalarida orqa chuvalchangning qolgan qismi bilan birga zararlanadi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

description.en: Anterior part of the biventer lobule on the inferior surface, lateral to the vermal pyramid.
description.uz: Pastki yuzadagi ikki qorinli (biventer) bo'lakchaning oldingi qismi; chuvalchang piramidasidan lateralda.

role.en: The second motor representation of the cerebellum (upper limb and hand, mouth) — co-activates with lobule V in movement and with somatosensory cortex in touch.
role.uz: Miyachaning ikkinchi harakat vakilligi (qo'l va kaft, og'iz) — harakatda V bo'lakcha, sezishda somatosensor po'stloq bilan birga faollashadi.

clinical.en: Together with VIIIb the seat of upper-limb ataxia in inferior cerebellar (PICA) infarcts.
clinical.uz: VIIIb bilan birga pastki miyacha (PICA) infarktlarida qo'l ataksiyasining joyi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

description.en: The anterior part of the vermal pyramid on the inferior vermis.
description.uz: Pastki chuvalchangdagi chuvalchang piramidasining oldingi qismi.

role.en: Axial motor control of the trunk and lower limbs during stance and gait.
role.uz: Tik turish va yurishda tana va oyoqlarning o'q harakat nazorati.

clinical.en: Vermal VIII lesions produce truncal titubation and gait ataxia.
clinical.uz: Chuvalchang VIII zararlanishi gavda tebranishi (titubatsiya) va yurish ataksiyasini beradi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

description.en: Posterior part of the biventer lobule, adjacent to the tonsil (hemispheric IX) on the inferior surface.
description.uz: Ikki qorinli bo'lakchaning orqa qismi; pastki yuzada bodomcha (yarim shar IX) yoniga tutash.

role.en: Continuation of the second motor map — lower limb and foot representation.
role.uz: Ikkinchi harakat xaritasining davomi — oyoq va tovon vakilligi.

clinical.en: Inferior cerebellar (PICA) infarcts involving VIIIb produce ipsilateral leg ataxia and lateropulsion.
clinical.uz: VIIIb'ni qamrab olgan pastki miyacha (PICA) infarktlari o'sha tomonda oyoq ataksiyasi va lateropulsiya beradi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

description.en: The posterior part of the vermal pyramid.
description.uz: Chuvalchang piramidasining orqa qismi.

role.en: Axial motor control; with the fastigial nucleus, drives vestibulospinal and reticulospinal postural pathways.
role.uz: O'q harakat nazorati; chodirsimon yadro bilan birga vestibulospinal va retikulospinal postural yo'llarni boshqaradi.

clinical.en: Contributes to truncal ataxia in midline cerebellar lesions.
clinical.uz: O'rta chiziq miyacha zararlanishlarida gavda ataksiyasiga hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

description.en: The cerebellar tonsil — the hemispheric part of lobule IX — a rounded lobule on the inferomedial surface lying just above the foramen magnum beside the medulla.
description.uz: Miyacha bodomchasi — IX bo'lakchaning yarim shar qismi — pastki-medial yuzada, katta teshikdan sal yuqorida, uzunchoq miya yonidagi yumaloq bo'lakcha.

role.en: Receives vestibular and visual-motion input; involved in the default-mode network and in autonomic (cardiovascular) modulation.
role.uz: Vestibulyar va ko'rish-harakat signallarini oladi; sukut rejimi tarmog'i va vegetativ (yurak-qon tomir) modulyatsiyada ishtirok etadi.

clinical.en: Tonsillar herniation: descent >5 mm below the foramen magnum in Chiari I malformation or acute herniation from raised ICP, compressing the medulla — the reason lumbar puncture is dangerous with a posterior-fossa mass.
clinical.uz: Bodomcha churrasi: Chiari I malformatsiyasida yoki yuqori ICP'da katta teshikdan >5 mm tushib uzunchoq miyani bosadi — orqa chuqurcha o'smasida lumbal punksiya xavfli bo'lishining sababi.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Cerebellar tonsil

description.en: The uvula — the vermal part of lobule IX between the two tonsils on the inferior vermis, facing the fourth ventricle.
description.uz: Uvula — pastki chuvalchangda ikki bodomcha orasidagi, IV qorinchaga qaragan IX bo'lakchaning chuvalchang qismi.

role.en: Vestibular vermis: with the nodulus it processes vestibular and optokinetic input for balance and the velocity-storage mechanism of the VOR.
role.uz: Vestibulyar chuvalchang: nodulus bilan birga muvozanat va VOR'ning tezlik-saqlash mexanizmi uchun vestibulyar va optokinetik signallarni qayta ishlaydi.

clinical.en: Uvular/nodular lesions produce positional nystagmus and vertigo mimicking peripheral vestibular disease.
clinical.uz: Uvula/nodulus zararlanishi periferik vestibulyar kasallikka o'xshash pozitsion nistagm va bosh aylanishini beradi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

description.en: The flocculus — a small tuft of folia projecting into the cerebellopontine angle below the middle cerebellar peduncle, connected to the nodulus by the thin peduncle of the flocculus.
description.uz: Flokkulus — o'rta miyacha oyoqchasi ostida ko'prik-miyacha burchagiga chiqib turuvchi kichik bargchalar to'dasi; nodulus bilan ingichka flokkulus oyoqchasi orqali bog'langan.

role.en: Vestibulo-ocular reflex adaptation, smooth pursuit and gaze holding via direct projections to the vestibular nuclei.
role.uz: Vestibulyar yadrolarga bevosita proyeksiyalar orqali vestibulo-okulyar refleks moslashuvi, silliq kuzatish va qarashni ushlab turish.

clinical.en: Flocculus lesions (vestibular schwannoma surgery, PICA infarct) cause gaze-evoked and downbeat nystagmus, impaired pursuit and VOR gain abnormalities.
clinical.uz: Flokkulus zararlanishi (vestibulyar shvannoma jarrohligi, PICA infarkti) qarashga bog'liq va pastga uruvchi nistagm, kuzatish buzilishi va VOR kuchayishi anomaliyalarini beradi.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Flocculus

description.en: The nodulus — the most anterior-inferior vermal lobule, forming the front of the inferior vermis above the roof of the fourth ventricle (inferior medullary velum).
description.uz: Nodulus — chuvalchangning eng oldingi-pastki bo'lakchasi; IV qorincha tomi (pastki miya pardasi) ustida pastki chuvalchang oldini hosil qiladi.

role.en: Core of the vestibulocerebellum: sets the time-constant of the velocity-storage mechanism, controls gravity-referenced eye movements and posture.
role.uz: Vestibulotserebellumning o'zagi: tezlik-saqlash mexanizmi vaqt doimiysini belgilaydi, tortishishga nisbatan ko'z harakatlari va gavda holatini boshqaradi.

clinical.en: Nodular lesions produce periodic alternating nystagmus and central positional vertigo; medulloblastoma classically arises from the roof of the fourth ventricle next to it.
clinical.uz: Nodulus zararlanishi davriy almashinuvchi nistagm va markaziy pozitsion bosh aylanishini beradi; medulloblastoma klassik ravishda uning yonida, IV qorincha tomidan boshlanadi.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Flocculonodular lobe

description.en: The largest and most lateral deep nucleus — a crumpled, bag-like lamina of grey matter in the white matter of each hemisphere, opening medially (hilum) toward the superior cerebellar peduncle.
description.uz: Eng yirik va eng lateral chuqur yadro — har yarim shar oq moddasida burmalangan, xaltasimon kulrang modda qatlami; medialda (hilum) yuqori miyacha oyoqchasiga ochiladi.

role.en: Output of the cerebrocerebellum: the dentato-rubro-thalamic tract to the contralateral VL thalamus and motor/prefrontal cortex — initiation, planning and timing of skilled movement and cognition.
role.uz: Tserebrotserebellum chiqishi: qarama-qarshi VL talamus va harakat/prefrontal po'stloqqa dentato-rubro-talamik trakt — nozik harakat va kognitsiyani boshlash, rejalash va vaqtlash.

clinical.en: Damage to the dentate or its efferents in posterior-fossa surgery causes cerebellar mutism; hypertrophic olivary degeneration follows dentate lesions; gadolinium retention and metabolic disorders (Wilson, Leigh) show here on MRI. The dentato-rubro-thalamic tract is the tractographic DBS target for tremor.
clinical.uz: Orqa chuqurcha jarrohligida tishsimon yadro yoki chiqish tolalari jarohati miyacha mutizmini beradi; tishsimon yadro zararlanishidan so'ng gipertrofik zaytun degeneratsiyasi; gadoliniy to'planishi va metabolik kasalliklar (Wilson, Leigh) MRTda shu yerda ko'rinadi. Dentato-rubro-talamik trakt — tremorda DBS'ning traktografik nishoni.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Dentate nucleus
Diedrichsen et al. 2011, NeuroImage — Imaging the deep cerebellar nuclei

description.en: The emboliform and globose nuclei together, medial to the dentate hilum and lateral to the fastigial nucleus.
description.uz: Tishsimon yadro hilumidan medialda va chodirsimon yadrodan lateraldagi tiqinsimon va sharsimon yadrolar birgalikda.

role.en: Output of the spinocerebellum (intermediate zone): to the contralateral red nucleus (rubrospinal tract) and VL thalamus — adjusts limb movement in progress and agonist–antagonist timing.
role.uz: Spinotserebellum (oraliq zona) chiqishi: qarama-qarshi qizil yadro (rubrospinal trakt) va VL talamusga — davom etayotgan oyoq-qo'l harakati va agonist–antagonist vaqtlashini sozlaydi.

clinical.en: Lesions produce limb ataxia, intention tremor and dysdiadochokinesia; classical conditioning of the eyeblink reflex depends on the anterior interposed nucleus.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi oyoq-qo'l ataksiyasi, intension tremor va disdiadoxokineziya beradi; ko'z pirpiratish refleksining klassik shartlanishi oldingi oraliq yadroga bog'liq.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Interposed nucleus
Diedrichsen et al. 2011, NeuroImage — Imaging the deep cerebellar nuclei
